_comment: Free CC0 assets applied on top of the blockout. Assets stay untracked (LFS uploads are blocked from the build environment) — this file carries provenance and URLs; tools/fetch_free_assets.sh restores everything from it. Scales were computed from measured model AABBs against the primitive sizes they replace (see git history).

codemanu_pixel_fx.name: CodeManu / DavitMasia — Free Pixel Effects Pack
codemanu_pixel_fx.license_evidence: The pack's own README.txt travels with the PNGs: 'This is a public domain asset, you can use it for both personal and comercial purposes. No credit required but feel free to show us where you used it on @DavitMasia and @CodeManuPro at twitter. Frame size is 100x100px.' Installed at assets/vfx/pixel/LICENSE_codemanu.txt. NOTE: opengameart.org is unreachable from the build environment, so the upstream page was NOT read directly — this rests on the license file shipped alongside the pixels, corroborated by several independent integrators. One catalog lists it as CC-BY-4.0, so the credit line above is included in-repo regardless.
codemanu_pixel_fx.note: 100x100 cells. EVERY sheet used here has an EMPTY cell at grid index 0 and trailing padding blanks — data/vfx/pixel/*.tres carry first_frame=1 and an exact frame_count for that reason. 10_weaponhit is 97% white and is installed twice as one texture with two tints (friendly violet, hostile warm).

_rejected_fx_packs._note: Evaluated and REJECTED on license grounds. Recorded so nobody re-researches them.
_rejected_fx_packs.untiedgames_super_pixel_effects: license.txt: 'You may not publicly distribute the contents of this zip file in whole or in part, unless as part of a game or application product' — forbids raw files in a source repo.
_rejected_fx_packs.BDragon1727_effect_packs: 'Free to use on non-commercial games' — this project may be sold.
_rejected_fx_packs.zerie_tiny_rpg: Contested: one integrator claims CC0, another's audit says raw redistribution is restricted. Treated as unusable until confirmed at source.
_rejected_fx_packs.pimen_spell_packs: No license file travels with the files; vendored credits contradict each other ('Author License' vs 'CC 4.0'). Unverified.
_rejected_fx_packs.tbbk_sword_slash: The ONLY redistribution-plausible pixel slash arc found (192x141, 3x3 of 64x47, 100% white, ideal for the Sword Wisp). CC0 1.0 is asserted only by a third-party README (BlueRaddish/primordial-countdown), not by a license file travelling with the art, and opengameart.org is unreachable from here. NOT installed pending confirmation from an unblocked machine: https://opengameart.org/content/pixel-art-sword-slash-effect

title_key_art.source: Generated for this project via Higgsfield (nano_banana_pro), 1376x768
title_key_art.note: Anime key visual: the Tower Exile with all three summons in Sunfall Ward, bell tower behind. Owner-commissioned for the title screen. CDN links expire — if the fetch 404s, regenerate rather than chasing the URL. `bytes` is checked on fetch: an existing file of a different size is a STALE copy from an older link and is replaced. Skipping on mere existence meant an earlier hand-downloaded image silently blocked this one forever.

You can use this content for personal, educational, and commercial purposes." Created and distributed by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), Fantasy UI Borders 1.0, 03-12-2023.
kenney_fantasy_ui_borders.source: Kenney — Fantasy UI Borders 1.0, via the series-ai/jam-ready-assets mirror
kenney_fantasy_ui_borders.note: Fetched file-by-file over media.githubusercontent.com rather than cloned. The mirror stores these under Git LFS, and a plain clone dies with "smudge filter lfs failed"; the media host serves the real bytes. Every tile is pure white with the shape carried in alpha, which is why these fit a project whose palette is locked: they are tinted at runtime to violet/indigo and never bring a colour of their own. Border and Panel are complementary halves of one frame — Panel is the solid field with the ornament knocked OUT of it, Border is the ornament alone. Layer Panel dark underneath and Border bright on top.

kenney_nature_kit.license_evidence: License.txt shipped in the pack: "License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0) http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ ... This content is free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects." Kenney, Nature Kit 2.1, 29-04-2020.
kenney_nature_kit.source: Kenney — Nature Kit 2.1, via the series-ai/jam-ready-assets mirror
kenney_nature_kit.note: Ground scatter only — grass tufts, low plants, flowers, small mushrooms and pebbles. Deliberately NOT the trees, cliffs, fences or buildings from the same pack: Sunfall Ward is a blockout the guide wants built from primitives, and this is dressing for it, not a replacement for it. Purple flowers because the friendly half of the palette is violet; the red and yellow ones are left behind so a hostile colour never grows out of the floor. GLB rather than FBX so Godot imports without FBX2glTF.

scatter_models._note: Ground cover, drawn with MultiMeshInstance3D rather than as scene instances. The playtest note: "The assets that are sitting around seem very bland and are just kind of sitting there ... definitely need some growth of like grass and different things around or like moss on the walls." A few hundred tufts as separate nodes would cost a few hundred draw calls; as instances of one mesh they cost one each. `weight` is the relative chance of a slot drawing this model. `wall` entries grow along the wall bases (the moss line); the rest scatter over the open floor. None of it collides — grass a player bumps into is worse than no grass.
scatter_models._tint_note: Every entry carries a tint, and it is not decoration. Kenney's nature kit greens read TEAL against Sunfall Ward's warm sandstone — and teal is the REWARD colour in this game (guide §4: gold/teal/soft-green = rewards). Grass the player might read as a pickup is worse than no grass. These are warm sages and olives instead, dulled so the ground cover sits behind the actors rather than competing with them. The violet on the flowers is the friendly side of the palette and is the one saturated note allowed.
